description.baseEffect:
Tier 1 · 2 Actions · Range 6 · Blast 3 · Concentration: Up to 10 minutes.

Create a visual illusion of your choice. Creatures make an INT save to see through the illusion if they would damage or interact with it.
description.upcastEffect: Upcast: Tier 2 & 3: +2 sensory elements each tier: touch, smell, hearing, taste. Tier 4+: Blast +1 or +10 minute duration. If Tier 3+, you can use 1 Action to move or change the illusion while in Range. If 5+ mana is spent, appropriate illusions can inflict Impaired or Hampered conditions, 1 turn, when a creature interacting with it fails its INT save. If 7+ mana is spent, lasts its duration without Concentration.
